body: Note this would be broken if assigned a custom big texture as the "ReloadSmall" icon. Using `draw_texture_rect` instead could prevent that. But it seems to be broken like that in the existing code though. 🤔 Example custom editor theme: In action: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c0525615-2616-4a97-9ae1-5175a2818ea3
As you said, this would affect most icons drawn by the inspector. Addressing this should be its own PR.
We usually don't care about theme icons anyway; not sure if anyone even customizes them. Custom class icons are what's important (not ivolved here).
